question: Given the same 24 correspondence records, how many contradictions does the official Causal Testing Framework test-case path reject?
population: All 24 records of results/evidence-correspondence/completed/cases (6 valid, 18 controlled contradictions); no record is added, removed, or re-labelled.

arms.ctf-api: ctf_comparison.oracle.compare_receipt: the official CausalTestCase.execute_test path with the exact-observation estimator and declared-predicate effect, followed by comparison of each recomputed stage outcome with the recorded stage verdict.
arms.ctf-api-with-hash-binding: The ctf-api arm preceded by the comparison harness's canonical plan and input digest checks (ctf_comparison.run).

decision_rule: A record is rejected by an arm when the arm raises an input error or at least one recomputed stage outcome differs from the recorded verdict; otherwise it is accepted.
labels: Validity labels are read only after every arm has produced its decision for every record.
success_criterion: None. The counts are reported whatever they are; the comparison measures which associations each interface checks, not which framework is better.
